description: Search customers by name, email, phone, company, or service address, and/or filter by tag. Housecall Pro matches the query against service addresses too, so a street can be searched for directly - useful when a caller gives an address and not a name. Rows carry each customer's addresses, so two people with the same name can be told apart without a second call; use hcp_get_customer for full detail. Free-text search does NOT cover tags - to find customers carrying a tag, pass tag_ids (get ids from hcp_list_tags).

query.description: Free-text search (name, email, phone, company, service address)

tag_ids.description: Only customers carrying these tag ids (tag_...), from hcp_list_tags

name: hcp_search_customers
